Variants.Content: Direwolves are larger than ordinary wolves and are mainly found in the North and north of the Great Wall. They have strong hunting abilities and territorial awareness. The Stark family wears it as their coat of arms; when encountering a direwolf in the wilderness, fire, numbers, and not scattering your mount are more important than showing off your strength.
